caption: The drawing depicts a dark brown, jointed wooden figure resembling a human with articulated arms and legs. The figure is shown standing upright, with its arms bent and hands closed into fists positioned near its thighs. The face is detailed with carved features, including wide eyes, a pronounced nose, and lips shaded in a reddish-brown color. The figure is adorned with a tall, cylindrical dark hat that sits atop its head. The joints at the shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, and ankles are clearly marked, giving the impression of a wooden mannequin or puppet. The background is plain and light in color, with no additional objects or patterns present, and the artist's signature appears at the bottom right corner.
title: Dancing Doll
